addendum_after_first_run:
Written after the first fixed-tree run failed and during debugging; the original
claims/bounds above are unchanged. Two additional latent defects in the inherited
SEH64 tree (both provably never exercised before: the shipped fixture carried an
unconditional 'BISECT-1: kit only' early return at worker-seh64.h that skipped
every raise past the walker kit, so the raise/dispatch/recover path had never run
in any validated receipt of worker-seh64-family or worker-dll-8fam-combined --
their receipts' claims that the full -130..-137 exercise ran are contradicted by
the shipped bytes):
F-3: svc_raise_exception (the RaiseException substrate entry) captured ITS OWN
frame, so the dispatch search pass always started at a driver-side frame with no
unwind info and every exception went unhandled. Fixed OS-faithfully with a naked
entry shim (svc_raise_exception) that captures the raise CALLER's context before
any compiler frame exists (nonvolatiles live), rewrites rip/rsp to the caller's
call site, then calls the C dispatch body (svc_raise_body) and rets to the
caller. One software raise in flight at a time (static context); documented.
F-4: __C_specific_handler scope-table handling did not match the actual
clang x86_64-pc-windows-msvc encoding: __finally scopes are {Handler=finally
funclet, JumpTarget=0}, not {Handler=0}; the shipped code invoked finally
funclets as FILTERS on the search pass with a wrong PSP (corrupting live frames)
and never ran them on the unwind pass. Fixed: finally scopes are skipped on
search and invoked on unwind via a new two-argument control hook
(call_at_frame2) that delivers the PSP in rdx (clang funclets read rdx; verified
against emitted funclets: frame register = PSP + 0x20) -- the PSP is the frame's
call-site rsp, not the SET_FPREG establisher frame.
Negative-control outcomes: with ONLY the trampoline bytes reverted (0x30->0x28,
0x28(%rsi)->0x20(%rsi)), every control variant wedges the host driver
deterministically at the FIRST real filter-funclet invocation (the -138 SSE
filter guard): with the aligned-spill fixture the funclet's rsp-relative aligned
movaps is present (disassembly verified); even with all SSE removed the funclet
still does not return through the misaligned entry. The fixed tree runs the same
funclet green twice, deterministically.
